title: Require Native Telemetry Provider Ownership
forbids: a production source import of the retired core telemetry singleton or native telemetry construction packages outside the OpenTelemetry provider
why: The app selects one neutral telemetry resource and the OpenTelemetry provider owns vendor construction for that process. Keeping construction imports inside the provider prevents another singleton, exporter, processor, or signal-provider lifecycle from becoming reachable.
remediate: Consume @habitat-ai/resource-telemetry or the active @opentelemetry/api context from application code. Keep SDK, exporter, processor, propagation, and native instrumentation construction inside resources/telemetry/providers/opentelemetry-node.
message: Native telemetry construction belongs only to the OpenTelemetry provider.
